title: Hatchling
tagline: A pocket pet for your cockpit: a Thargoid larva, a Remlok bot or an exobiology sample, raised by how you really play.
description: It lives in real time, Void Compass open or not. Feed it from a larder you stock by buying food at real markets, play with it, vent the hold and turn the lights out. Exploring keeps it curious; combat scares it; a rebuy upsets it badly. It grows from egg to adult over real days, and how you raised it picks its adult form. Neglected, it hibernates: medicine brings it back, if you're in time. It can sit on your screen as an overlay too (Overlay Studio).
